checks.label: Three switches, each set one of two ways, give 8 different names, from Hydraulic pump, fixed to Air motor, variable
Out and solid is a hydraulic pump, in and solid a hydraulic motor, out and empty an air compressor, in and empty an air motor, and the arrow only turns fixed into variable
The point of the triangle touches the circle in a pump, and its tail touches the circle in a motor
The symbol carries no design structure: beside a gear cutaway, a piston cutaway or both, the pump is drawn the same and keeps the same name
Each quarter-turn leaves the name the same, and four turns bring the symbol back as it started
Worked by hand: the jack holds up 2000 N (slips 5, 100 and 20), 2 of the 5 parts run on air (slips 3 and 1), and 2 of the 5 circles are pumps (slips 1, 3, 4 and 5); the typed fields ask exactly these
Six symbols and six cards: each symbol sticks only on its own card, and all six can be matched
Before an answer nothing gives it away: puzzles open with no switches, no rings and no lit marks, the jack shows no load, and the two naming puzzles show the name as ?
Every demonstration settles within 4.5 s of its screen opening, and every answer's motion within 3 s
